# SERA

From VLM Planners to Robotic Agents: Self-Evolving Harnesses for History-Dependent Manipulation

**2026-10-21 · Preprint · University of Science and Technology of China**

**[Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29560)** · [Project](https://stevenkkxs.github.io/sera-webpage/) · [Code](https://github.com/StevenKKXS/SERA)

An editable planner harness retains task context and evolves from rollouts while a fixed VLA executes grounded subgoals.

<img src="../../../website/public/images/catalog/sera-policy.webp" width="760" alt="Figure 1: From planner to agent for history-dependent manipulation. Top: Similar observations can require different decisions depending on task progress. (a) Memory-augmented policies equip VLA models with memory mechanisms to retain and use historical information. (b) Hierarchical planning separates high-level planning from low-level execution. (c) SERA uses an editable harness to organize the VLM as an agent that maintains task context from observation and interaction history. Execution-driven"/>

*SERA authors · [Figure source](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.29560) · Original rights retained.*

**Scope and qualifications**

- Published leaderboard baselines and the paper’s local MemER reproduction are separate comparisons.
- Self-evolution uses development experience; evaluation uses the selected frozen harness.
